legalName: The East Ohio Gas Company d/b/a Enbridge Gas Ohio
summary: Reverse the proposed IFM company creation and owner addition. The East Ohio Gas Company, now doing business as Enbridge Gas Ohio, was acquired by Enbridge Elephant Holdings and remains a wholly owned strategic subsidiary of Enbridge Inc.
survivorCondition: Do not create an IFM PortCo or add IFM ownership. Treat Enbridge Gas Ohio as an operating alias of The East Ohio Gas Company and exclude it from the infrastructure-fund PortCo census.
